from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

INF = 1e20


def rgb(hex_value: int) -> np.ndarray:
    return np.array([(hex_value >> 16) & 255, (hex_value >> 8) & 255, hex_value & 255], dtype=np.float32) / 255.0


@dataclass
class Primitive:
    kind: str
    name: str
    center: tuple[float, float, float]
    size: tuple[float, float, float]
    color: tuple[float, float, float]
    emissive: float = 0.0
    params: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class SceneDef:
    scene_id: str
    title: str
    kind: str
    camera: tuple[float, float, float]
    objects: list[Primitive]
    room_bounds: tuple[tuple[float, float, float], tuple[float, float, float]] | None = None
    accent_wall: str = "back"
    targets: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)


def add_box(scene: SceneDef, name: str, center, size, color, emissive=0.0, **params):
    scene.objects.append(Primitive("box", name, tuple(center), tuple(size), tuple(color), emissive, params))


def add_ellipsoid(scene: SceneDef, name: str, center, radii, color, emissive=0.0, **params):
    scene.objects.append(Primitive("ellipsoid", name, tuple(center), tuple(radii), tuple(color), emissive, params))


def add_cylinder(scene: SceneDef, name: str, center, radius_height, color, emissive=0.0, **params):
    # size=(radius, height, radius), vertical Y cylinder
    r, h = radius_height
    scene.objects.append(Primitive("cylinder", name, tuple(center), (r, h, r), tuple(color), emissive, params))


def target(scene: SceneDef, key: str, point, width_deg: float, height_deg: float):
    ox, oy, oz = scene.camera
    px, py, pz = point
    dx, dy, dz = px - ox, py - oy, pz - oz
    dist_xz = math.hypot(dx, dz)
    yaw = math.atan2(dx, dz)
    pitch = math.atan2(dy, dist_xz)
    scene.targets[key] = {
        "yaw": yaw,
        "pitch": pitch,
        "width": math.radians(width_deg),
        "height": math.radians(height_deg),
    }


def build_living() -> SceneDef:
    s = SceneDef("living", "거실 · 폭염특보와 실내 냉방", "room", (0.0, 1.6, 0.0), [], ((-5.5, 0.0, -5.2), (5.5, 3.3, 5.2)), "back")
    # Large architectural features
    add_box(s, "window", (-3.4, 1.75, -5.08), (3.0, 2.1, 0.08), (0.34, 0.72, 0.92), emissive=0.8)
    add_box(s, "window_frame_v", (-3.4, 1.75, -5.0), (0.08, 2.15, 0.12), (0.92, 0.94, 0.95))
    add_box(s, "window_frame_h", (-3.4, 1.75, -5.0), (3.05, 0.08, 0.12), (0.92, 0.94, 0.95))
    add_box(s, "curtain_l", (-5.05, 1.65, -4.86), (0.5, 2.6, 0.18), (0.18, 0.44, 0.55))
    add_box(s, "curtain_r", (-1.78, 1.65, -4.86), (0.5, 2.6, 0.18), (0.18, 0.44, 0.55))

    # TV wall at +Z, visible behind viewer when rotated
    add_box(s, "tv_body", (2.75, 1.65, 4.95), (3.5, 1.9, 0.18), (0.035, 0.045, 0.055))
    add_box(s, "tv_screen", (2.75, 1.65, 4.82), (3.18, 1.58, 0.08), (0.94, 0.36, 0.13), emissive=0.95)
    # Screen visual cards, no text
    add_box(s, "tv_alert_bar", (2.75, 2.22, 4.76), (2.7, 0.22, 0.04), (0.99, 0.84, 0.23), emissive=1.0)
    add_box(s, "tv_map", (2.18, 1.55, 4.75), (1.35, 0.9, 0.04), (0.92, 0.22, 0.15), emissive=0.85)
    add_box(s, "tv_info", (3.35, 1.55, 4.75), (0.72, 0.9, 0.04), (0.98, 0.75, 0.45), emissive=0.65)
    add_box(s, "tv_console", (2.75, 0.58, 4.6), (4.0, 0.65, 0.75), (0.24, 0.19, 0.15))

    # Sofa and rug
    add_box(s, "rug", (-0.9, 0.035, 1.1), (4.2, 0.06, 2.8), (0.58, 0.32, 0.15))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "sofa_shadow", (-2.0, 0.075, 2.75), (2.15, 0.05, 0.82), (0.12, 0.12, 0.10))
    add_box(s, "sofa_base", (-2.0, 0.48, 2.7), (3.9, 0.75, 1.25), (0.11, 0.39, 0.43))
    add_box(s, "sofa_back", (-2.0, 1.12, 3.12), (3.9, 1.2, 0.45), (0.12, 0.45, 0.48))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "cushion_l", (-2.85, 1.0, 2.5), (0.65, 0.35, 0.48), (0.92, 0.66, 0.28))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "cushion_r", (-1.25, 1.0, 2.5), (0.65, 0.35, 0.48), (0.84, 0.30, 0.20))

    # Coffee table and remote/phone
    add_ellipsoid(s, "table_shadow", (0.15, 0.075, 1.35), (1.5, 0.04, 0.78), (0.13, 0.12, 0.10))
    add_box(s, "table_top", (0.15, 0.58, 1.35), (2.6, 0.15, 1.25), (0.40, 0.22, 0.11))
    for x in (-0.9, 1.2):
        for z in (0.95, 1.75):
            add_box(s, "table_leg", (x, 0.28, z), (0.14, 0.55, 0.14), (0.18, 0.14, 0.11))
    add_box(s, "remote", (0.55, 0.7, 1.2), (0.35, 0.08, 0.75), (0.045, 0.055, 0.065))
    add_box(s, "remote_display", (0.55, 0.745, 1.0), (0.22, 0.015, 0.22), (0.21, 0.92, 0.95), emissive=0.9)
    add_box(s, "phone", (-0.55, 0.72, 1.35), (0.42, 0.08, 0.78), (0.03, 0.04, 0.05))
    add_box(s, "phone_screen", (-0.55, 0.77, 1.35), (0.35, 0.02, 0.64), (0.98, 0.78, 0.18), emissive=1.0)

    # AC and circulator
    add_box(s, "ac", (3.55, 2.52, -4.95), (2.8, 0.62, 0.28), (0.93, 0.96, 0.98))
    add_box(s, "ac_vent", (3.55, 2.34, -4.76), (2.35, 0.16, 0.06), (0.10, 0.18, 0.22))
    add_cylinder(s, "fan_pole", (-4.15, 0.85, 2.25), (0.11, 1.45), (0.28, 0.32, 0.34))
    add_cylinder(s, "fan_base", (-4.15, 0.12, 2.25), (0.52, 0.18), (0.22, 0.25, 0.27))
    add_cylinder(s, "fan_ring", (-4.15, 1.65, 2.25), (0.62, 0.16), (0.35, 0.39, 0.41))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "fan_center", (-4.15, 1.65, 2.18), (0.16, 0.16, 0.12), (0.11, 0.14, 0.16))
    # Plant and ceiling lights
    add_cylinder(s, "plant_pot", (4.55, 0.42, 2.85), (0.38, 0.72), (0.54, 0.28, 0.16))
    for px, pz, rr in [(4.25,2.85,0.55),(4.68,2.68,0.62),(4.63,3.08,0.5)]:
        add_ellipsoid(s, "plant_leaf", (px, 1.15, pz), (rr, 0.8, rr*0.45), (0.12, 0.47, 0.24))
    add_cylinder(s, "ceiling_light", (0.0, 3.12, 0.0), (0.72, 0.13), (0.98, 0.88, 0.58), emissive=0.9)
    # Door to entryway
    add_box(s, "door", (-5.38, 1.35, -1.25), (0.16, 2.7, 1.8), (0.42, 0.27, 0.16))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "door_handle", (-5.25, 1.35, -0.62), (0.08, 0.08, 0.08), (0.85, 0.70, 0.28), emissive=0.2)

    target(s, "tv", (2.75, 1.65, 4.78), 27, 18)
    target(s, "phone", (-0.55, 0.75, 1.35), 10, 10)
    target(s, "remote", (0.55, 0.73, 1.2), 9, 12)
    target(s, "fan", (-4.15, 1.65, 2.2), 16, 19)
    target(s, "door", (-5.25, 1.45, -1.25), 18, 30)
    return s


def build_entry() -> SceneDef:
    s = SceneDef("entry", "현관 · 여름 외출 준비", "room", (0.0, 1.6, 0.0), [], ((-4.8, 0.0, -4.8), (4.8, 3.15, 4.8)), "left")
    # Main door and shoe cabinet
    add_box(s, "front_door", (0.0, 1.45, 4.67), (2.45, 2.9, 0.22), (0.20, 0.27, 0.30))
    add_box(s, "door_panel", (0.0, 1.5, 4.52), (1.9, 2.35, 0.08), (0.31, 0.38, 0.40))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "door_handle", (0.83, 1.48, 4.37), (0.09, 0.09, 0.09), (0.87, 0.72, 0.29), emissive=0.2)
    add_ellipsoid(s, "cabinet_shadow", (-3.55, 0.05, 3.8), (1.05, 0.04, 0.75), (0.13, 0.12, 0.10))
    add_box(s, "shoe_cabinet", (-3.55, 0.72, 3.8), (1.85, 1.35, 1.2), (0.60, 0.49, 0.34))
    add_box(s, "bench", (2.75, 0.46, 3.65), (2.3, 0.48, 0.85), (0.44, 0.30, 0.20))
    add_box(s, "bench_cushion", (2.75, 0.75, 3.65), (2.15, 0.18, 0.75), (0.16, 0.46, 0.50))

    # Mirror and wall hooks
    add_box(s, "mirror", (-4.66, 1.75, -1.1), (0.12, 2.2, 1.5), (0.42, 0.78, 0.86), emissive=0.35)
    add_box(s, "hook_bar", (4.65, 2.0, -0.8), (0.15, 0.18, 2.3), (0.18, 0.17, 0.16))
    for z in (-1.65, -0.85, -0.05):
        add_ellipsoid(s, "hook", (4.52, 1.86, z), (0.11, 0.11, 0.11), (0.76, 0.60, 0.27), emissive=0.15)

    # Bag on bench

    add_ellipsoid(s, "bag_handle", (2.7, 1.48, 3.55), (0.42, 0.28, 0.10), (0.25, 0.16, 0.10))

    # Items placed around the entry
    # Parasol
    add_cylinder(s, "parasol_shaft", (-3.95, 0.88, 0.75), (0.055, 1.7), (0.55, 0.40, 0.22))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "parasol", (-3.95, 1.68, 0.75), (0.25, 0.75, 0.25), (0.93, 0.22, 0.25))
    # Cap
    add_ellipsoid(s, "cap", (-2.55, 1.55, -4.48), (0.52, 0.30, 0.44), (0.97, 0.76, 0.18))
    add_box(s, "cap_brim", (-2.55, 1.36, -4.18), (0.75, 0.08, 0.55), (0.96, 0.72, 0.1
